text: Based on the Earth-observation data, tree-cover loss on the property has shown a decreasing trend in recent years. The loss events were 81.3 ha in 2021, 0.6 ha in 2022, and 4.5 ha in 2023. While there was a significant loss in 2021, the subsequent years saw much smaller areas affected. Therefore, tree-cover loss has not been increasing in recent years.
